title: Entra ID and on-premises Active Directory: sync and federation

videos.script: Many companies already have a directory. It runs in the office, on servers called domain controllers. It is Active Directory. {{ad}} Entra ID sounds like the same thing, moved to the cloud. It is not. It speaks the web's protocols, for applications anywhere. {{entra}} So a company with both has one person in two directories. A program copies them across. {{sync}} Microsoft offers two such programs. One is a whole engine on a server. The other is a light agent, with the engine in the cloud. {{engines}} Copying the account is half the job. The other half is checking the password. {{check}} Entra ID can check it against a synchronised hash. It can hand it to an agent in the office. Or it can send the person to the company's own server. {{methods}} You will ask Entra ID which of those a domain uses. It answers anybody, because the sign-in page has to know. {{realm}} Everything else in this lesson needs a real directory, and the lesson says so. {{end}}
